snippet.title: A Game About Chopping Trees - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
“A game about chopping trees” is a meditative experience built for those who find peace in simple tasks — wrapped in a chill and relaxing atmosphere where there are no timers, no pressure, and no stress. Leave the noise of the world behind and step into the quiet, rhythmic life of a woodsman.
